# Release Checklist

- [ ] Branch clean and synced
- [ ] Documentation impact reviewed
- [ ] Lint passed
- [ ] Tests passed
- [ ] Build passed
- [ ] Product QA passed
- [ ] E2E smoke passed
- [ ] Firebase target changes identified
- [ ] Production-impacting deploy approved
- [ ] Post-deploy hard refresh checked
- [ ] Console/network checked
- [ ] Rollback path known
